create_list_item_marker_processor: create a ListItemMarkerProcessor instance to identify and process list item markers in Docling documents
process_document_list_markers: process a DoclingDocument to identify, convert, and merge list item markers into proper ListItems
update_list_items_in_place: update existing ListItems in a DoclingDocument in place by extracting marker and text from bullet or numbered patterns
merge_markers_and_text_items: merge marker-only TextItems with their following content TextItems into proper ListItems within a DoclingDocument
process_text_item_to_list: process a TextItem to detect bullet or numbered list formatting and convert it into a ListItem
